How do I get a transcript from Sophia or Study.com?

Study.com: Request a transcript from your account. Study.com can email you a PDF after final grades are posted. Transcript instructions ↗

Sophia: Check transcript options in your Sophia account. For an ACE transcript, accept your issued badges in Credly, then choose Send Transcripts → View Transcript to download a copy. ACE / Credly instructions ↗

You can upload unofficial copies here. DegreeSteps does not send official transcripts to colleges.
